h1: Connectivity Loyalty Programs: eSIM Rewards That Can Be Measured
reader: Loyalty or product lead in travel, membership, fintech or device brands

description.text: Design connectivity loyalty programs with eSIM terms, redemption flows, costs and measurement. Separate useful rewards from unproven retention claims.

snippet.exactText: Connectivity loyalty programs give eligible members mobile service as a reward, a points redemption or an included membership benefit. Branded mobile eSIM plans can deliver that benefit through an app or portal, but the programme still needs clear coverage, eligibility, redemption and support rules. Providing data does not, by itself, prove higher retention.
